title: Appointed as Assistant
original: As I am now, will my presence inconvenience you? Will I remind you of past miseries? I... long for being with you. When the time comes, we will leave this place together, okay?

title: Appointed as Assistant
original: I understand. Some thoughts lose meaning when expressed with words. It's fine. So long as those thoughts echo in your mind, so long as you still need me, I will be here by your side, and nowhere else.

title: Talk 1
original: You thought we could not survive if away from the sea? A myth, it is. My kin and I will soon be able to swim through the air. In the end, even those places devoid of anything will be our ocean. We simply need to evolve, and we only need to adapt.

title: Talk 1
original: No more rolling around in the frosting. You're an example to the fairies, the guardian of the garden. I won't clean you scale by scale, or wrap you in silk and put you in the clouds anymore... Of course, you can do anything you like. This may be my own wishful thinking, but I imagine you'd be willing to hear out my suggestions.

title: Talk 2
original: My former friends tried to grant me my eternal rest with their hands. They refused to confront their true selves, but I do not resent them, and I could not hurt them, even if they rejected and attacked me so vehemently... Perhaps everything I did was bringing them harm. My regrets died along with them.

title: Talk 2
original: The soil on the plains contain all souls' desires. Those thoughts, regrettable yet magnificent, despicable yet delicious. They are your food to enjoy. Are they sweet? Are they Sour? You must've figured out how to share them with me, right?

title: Talk 3
original: This box? My past lies within it...the fragments of my past. Fractured as they are, they still suffice to tell that I am not an empty puppet... that I am not a phantom. Gradually, I was reborn into what I am now, bit by bit.

title: Talk 3
original: Singing's not so hard. You only need to let your voice out of your throat. Your desires will shape sound itself, and I will write it into a score. Come, have a try. Sing the way you want. It'll be fun.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Dr. {@nickname}, was a future like this also in your past vision? You may have nothing but hatred for me now, but I do not fear it. Hate me as your heart desires... while you are still able to.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Once in the past, you loved to entwine yourself among my fingers. You breathed like a great dragon, but let out only faint squeaks. Just when did it all change...? Now you only hover above my head, looking at me from afar... I want to see you, without having to look up all the time. That's very tiring.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Your companions, Kal'tsit and Amiya, said that you are worthy of my trust until the very end. But one can never save the others. I failed to save my friends, and you failed to save yours. We both have lost everything, but I was granted a rebirth, and following that, a new future. This... is just unfair to you.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Amidst the sea of impulses and desires, I opened my eyes. You did, too. That's why I'm bringing you with me: to unleash our desires and break these shackles. But it looks like you have other ideas... I'm scolding you? Not at all. This is what makes you different, and I like it.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Long ago, my family was murdered when I was still in Ægir. I always assumed the sea monsters did it, but I never expected to learn that it was all the handiwork of the Ægir. My blood kin and my songs are scary, they all say, but they are wrong. It is the people who are scary.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: The fairies swallowed dreams, and so were shaped like those dreams. Plates roll and tumble across the ground; puppets chase one another;  seaflowers raise their instruments... Dreams become reality itself. If I were to become a little fairy myself, do you think... the distance between us might lessen?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: I did struggle, I did resist. But to what avail? When the tide rises, no traces of lesser lifeforms will remain undrowned. You are my very last friend. Will you also be like them, rejecting the ocean for a futile end, even if it costs you everything? Do you wish to be what I used to be?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: I found a scale in the nest. Are you starting to shed again? I will sing to you lullabies, take off your gown, and rinse that filth with warm water. Will you... refuse me? I promise you everything... so please, just this once, listen to what I demand.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Am I sick? Or am I still dreaming? I dreamt that the black sky was our ocean. When the others and I swam up, we did not feel ourselves sinking at all. Strange, so strange. Is this our future? Their faces are so blurry, they... They... No, no.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: The fairies are talking amongst themselves. They whisper: the guardian of the garden is lingering in the borderlands, trying to leave the plains. Then go. Go where you like and follow your nature. Bring your dream and my heart with you. Only then, will the you I well-acquainted return to my fingertips.

title: Idle
original: Dream... What kind of dream will you have? Where are you now? Will you find it there... just another dream?

title: Idle
original: Sleep soundly. I will be the residual melody in your sweet dreams.

title: Onboard
original: Dr. {@nickname}, I have been waiting for you. It's been so long, far too long that... I have forgotten why I am waiting for you here... But none of this is important anymore. It's not that important anymore.

title: Onboard
original: Spread your wings and squall to your heart's content. Everything is permitted in these red plains. Spread your joy and excitement to the fairies. Let them sing and frolic with them. I'll be waiting for you here.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: These things... I have seen them too many times. Nobody needs things like these anymore.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: This screen is cold and dull. Why don't we instead relish some fresh, living memories?

title: Promotion 1
original: Formalities of the past... what good are they now? Nothing has survived, except you and me. We will cast those aside, and all we need is to be a step closer... Join me, Dr. {@nickname}, and be my blood kin.

title: Promotion 1
original: There are no tasks or duties here. Our own satisfaction is the greatest reward. Indeed, I'm very satisfied now.

title: Promotion 2
original: Nevermore shall my eroded sword cleave, Nevermore shall my former friends breathe, and nevermore shall I feel the warm blood flow inside me. Still, I am satisfied. I have become one with the ocean. Doctor, come with me — your true form is still waiting for you beneath the waves.

title: Promotion 2
original: Fighting is the most primal of instincts, and there's no point in resisting it. If you're frightened, I can guide you forward.

title: Added to Squad
original: Fight alongside the others? Against whom?

title: Added to Squad
original: I will follow your words, and drift along the currents…

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: No more lives should be lost.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: You already have the answer in your mind. Why follow the commands of others?

title: Depart
original: What will it feel like... when their arms penetrate this body?

title: Depart
original: Watch your shadow. Don't let it be stolen.

title: Begin Operation
original: Treat me not as a calamity, for death is not my wish.

title: Begin Operation
original: Listen. The sound of a banquet.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: What do you wish to do? I shall obey.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Flowers wither, and petals dye the land red.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: No longer do I walk alone. My blood kin are with me.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Let instinct stain my name.

title: Deployment 1
original: Now, harken to the song of the distant sea...

title: Deployment 1
original: Don't send a thread into a knife's edge.

title: Deployment 2
original: Rest at ease. The tide also rises.

title: Deployment 2
original: Let me stir it.

title: In Battle 1
original: The sky and the land... both a drought to relieve.

title: In Battle 1
original: This song will never stop, not until the melody is written…

title: In Battle 2
original: May the song seep into your souls.

title: In Battle 2
original: The red velvet of life props up this dead diamond.

title: In Battle 3
original: With me, to our eternal home we will return.

title: In Battle 3
original: The moment you leave, I will take these lost dreams away.

title: In Battle 4
original: Fear not, my kin… The time is nigh.

title: In Battle 4
original: It was your determination that dyed my dress red.

title: 4-star Result
original: They will become our blood kin. They no longer need to feel the suffering of aridity. Their prior existence was already too painful.

title: 4-star Result
original: When you trust your instincts, victory is never far off. You use them well.

title: 3-star Result
original: Will you treat me the same way? Is this also the ending you designed for me? If that is what you wished for, I will not deny it.

title: 3-star Result
original: Fighting isn't complicated. You did well. You may have whatever reward you desire.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Why must you flee? This futile struggle will only bring about more senseless terror.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: You missed them? They must not be important.

title: Operation Failure
original: Run, Doctor... Run away, from here, from me... Leave.

title: Operation Failure
original: Come with me. We will live on, together.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Sooner or later, this place too will return to its primordial form.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Let the fairies redecorate. We'll come back later.

title: Tap
original: ...Why am I still wearing this hat?

title: Tap
original: Hehe…

title: Trust Tap
original: We failed to protect everything. The harmonious future is our only hope.

title: Trust Tap
original: Look into my eyes, and tell me the first word that comes to mind.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: I still remember this day... but time has no more significance at this point. The sea and sky, and all life, will never change anymore...

title: New Year's blessing
original: This is a holiday where humans celebrate their calendar cycle starting anew. You should go enjoy yourself. It must be very fun to swim among fireworks. Oh, and remember to save me a spark. I'll plant it in the garden.

title: Greeting
original: Doctor... Come, with me.

title: Greeting
original: Where are you flying off to today?

title: Birthday
original: I can feel the joy of a life being born... but, how should I share this joy with you...? Dr.{@nickname}, don't stray too far from me. We can embrace this new life, together...

title: Birthday
original: Normal cakes and pastries can't satisfy your hunger, can they? Maybe we could go with some new ideas. Hmm... A frosted galaxy? A chocolate mountain? Maybe a candied fruit forest? You still want human pastries...? Alright...

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Doctor, leave. There's nothing left in these ruins. Everything familiar has vanished. The memories still sting us... Doctor, do you hate what I say? But we've both lost our families, all of them... Would you become family with me, as I am now?

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Your wings have gotten stronger, and your scales are tougher now. I wonder how you'll look once you shed that robe. If only I could bend time to my will, the new, reborn you would be back at my side so much sooner.
